# ts-rs

Fetched: 17/10/2026 from https://docs.rs/ts-rs/latest/ts_rs/, and verified
against this repository's own build on the same day.
Version: ts-rs 12.0.1 (docs.rs lists 13/09/2026), MSRV 1.88.0.

## What this project uses

- `#[derive(TS)]` plus `#[ts(export)]` "generates a test which writes the
  bindings for it to disk", so `cargo test` writes them.
- Default output is `./bindings`; `TS_RS_EXPORT_DIR` overrides it. This repo
  sets it in `host/.cargo/config.toml` with `relative = true`, which resolves
  against `host/` (verified: output lands in `extension/src/`).
- `export_to = "wire.gen.ts"` on several types merges them into one file
  (verified). `serde_json::Value` needs feature `serde-json-impl` and is
  emitted as `JsonValue` in a sibling file `serde_json/JsonValue.ts`
  (verified).
- Feature `serde-compat` (default) reads serde's `tag`, `rename_all`,
  `rename_all_fields`, `skip_serializing_if` and `default`. Verified output:
  `#[serde(tag = "type")]` becomes a discriminated union on `"type"`; a field
  with `default` and `skip_serializing_if` becomes `field?: T | null`.
- Large integers (`u64`, `i64`, ...) follow `TS_RS_LARGE_INT`, default
  `bigint`; this repo sets `number` (verified: `id: number`).

## Errors

Unsupported serde attributes give a build warning unless the
`no-serde-warnings` feature is on. Other errors: not stated.

## Limits

`number` loses precision above 2^53; frame ids are counters and stay far
below it.

## Gotchas

- "`skip_serializing` and `skip_serializing_if` only take effect alongside
  `#[serde(default)]`."
- Generated files say "Do not edit this file manually"; change `wire.rs` and
  run `cargo test`.
